method: Every blob deleted from a live lib/agency or lib/management path on the first-parent history of main, absent from main (at any path) and from the canonical section repositories (561-group/561-group-services-section, causeway-services/public-services-section, red-cup-engineering/computer-services-section, red-cup-engineering/computer-code-development-engine) and the owner repositories the loss forensics checked, restored byte-for-byte into the nearest surviving section's lib/legacy/restored-from-main/<date>-<sha>/. Each unit carries its loss class: lost-by-merge-or-snapshot (a snapshot, bulk capture or lane integration) or deliberately-removed (a migration, retirement, extraction or restructure). Nothing is promoted to live lib/agency here.

The house's agency records have one layout: every section's offices, duties, works, skills, characters and incumbencies live under its lib/agency. The records twelve sections still kept under content/<pool> or lib/management/<pool> (Koios, koios.news, the corpus management service, the Hive fleet, Stripe, Kalshi, Polymarket, divination, attention allocation, linguistics, knowledge organization, the Obsmetrologia change-bundle qualification and Blockchain Trashpanda) move there, and their rosters name the new paths. Blockchain Trashpanda's live formation and production checks read the moved records at their new paths, while the founding manifest check keeps the historical founding paths it commits to. The agency registry reads lib/agency only.
